editorial.blurb: Kozy is a stunningly designed Korean restaurant where bold flavors meet thoughtful fusion, earning passionate repeat visits from everyone who walks through the door.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the dumplings early and don't skip dessert—the hotteok with ice cream is a perfect finish, and the lychee martini pairs beautifully with the meal.

topDishes.note: excellent enough to order a second round
